module: Table of vehicle electrical values (`electrics.values`) shared by all controllers, the UI and extensions, plus the logic of lights, turn signals, warning, light bar, horn and ignition level. A modder reads `electrics.values.xxx` to know the vehicle state (RPM, speed, lights...) and calls the `toggle_*`/`set_*` functions to act on the lights or the ignition key. Controllers and the jbeam (`electrics`/`components.electrics` sections) write their own keys in this table.
usage:
-- In a controller or a vehicle extension
local rpm = electrics.values.rpm
electrics.setIgnitionLevel(2)      -- ignition on, starter not engaged
electrics.set_warn_signal(true)     -- hazard lights
electrics.values.myCustomValue = 1 -- value then read by the UI / streams
notes: Update loop: electrics.updateGFX(dt) (1st step) -> controllers write their values -> electrics.updateGFXSecondStep(dt) (2nd step: brakelights, values imported from the network, override by ignition level, jbeam custom values, smoothers).

At the end of updateGFX, all booleans in electrics.values are converted to 0/1 (the keys listed in M.disabledState are set to nil). Values written afterwards (second step, controllers) may remain booleans: testing with `== 1` or `> 0` does not work for true.

Keys initialized in the file: throttle, brake, steering, clutch, wheelspeed, odometer, avgWheelAV, airspeed, horn, rpmspin, rpm, boost, boostMax. init/reset also add airflowspeed and electricalLoadCoef (=1) and ignitionLevel.

Keys written by updateGFX: accXSmooth/accYSmooth/accZSmooth (sensors.gx2/gy2/gz2), odometer and trip (partCondition, see that module for the unit), nop (=0), parkingbrake (copy of parkingbrake_input), parkingbrakelight, lights and lights_state (0 off, 1 low beam, 2 high beam), turnsignal (-1 left, 0, 1 right), airspeed (obj:getGroundSpeed(), misleading name: ground speed), airflowspeed (obj:getAirflowSpeed()), altitude (obj:getAltitude()), parking (always 0, TODO in the code), reverse (gearIndex < 0), signal_L/signal_R (turn signal on during the pulse), hazard, hazard_enabled, lightbar (0 off, 1 lights, 2 lights+siren), lowpressure (beamstate.lowpressure), oil (oiltemp >= 130), lowhighbeam, lowbeam, highbeam, fog, horn, lowhighbeam_signal_R/L (US style), highbeam_wigwag_R/L, reverse_wigwag_R/L, rpmTacho (rpm smoothed by a temporal sigmoid), rpmspin (angle in degrees of the RPM 'wheel', modulo 360), signal_right_input/signal_left_input (turn signal command state), boost (turboBoost + superchargerBoost), boostMax (max of turboBoostMax and superchargerBoostMax).
Keys written by updateGFXSecondStep: brakelights (ceil(brake) if not provided by a controller), brakelight_signal_R/L.

Keys READ but written elsewhere: ignitionLevel (also written here), gearIndex, oiltemp, watertemp, fuel, wigwag_R, wigwag_L, parkingbrake_input, turboBoost, turboBoostMax, superchargerBoost, superchargerBoostMax, steering (raw steering wheel degrees: thresholds 60 and 10 for the turn signal auto-cancel), rpm. Keys reset to 0 by the 'european' override when ignitionLevel == 0: brakelights, parkingbrakelight, brakelight_signal_R/L, parking, reverse, lights, lights_state, turnsignal, signal_L/R, hazard, hazard_enabled, lowpressure, oil, lowhighbeam, lowbeam, highbeam, fog, horn, lowhighbeam_signal_R/L, highbeam_wigwag_R/L, reverse_wigwag_R/L, signal_right_input, signal_left_input, fuel, lowfuel, abs, esc, tcs, oiltemp, watertemp, checkengine, ignition, running, engineRunning.

Default smoothers (exponential): wheelspeed, gear_A, rpm, lights, turnsignal, airspeed, airflowspeed, altitude (parameter 10); fuel, oiltemp, watertemp (parameter 100). The jbeam can replace them via electrics.smoothers (types exponential, temporal, temporalNonLinear). The smoothers are applied last, after the custom values.

Ignition levels: 0 off, 1 accessories, 2 run (engine allowed to run), 3 starter. Levels forbidden by jbeam (allowedIgnitionLevels, default {0,1,2,3}) are replaced by the nearest allowed higher level, otherwise lower. The initial level comes from the spawnVehicleIgnitionLevel setting (default 3) or from config.additionalVehicleData.spawnWithEngineRunning (true => 3, false => 0).

Jbeam: electrics.indicatorCycleTime (default 0.8 s, a half-cycle = duration of an on/off state), electrics.ignitionLevelOverrideType (only 'european' exists), electrics.allowedIgnitionLevels, electrics.smoothers, electrics.customValues (see electricsCustomValueParser).

The turn signal stops by itself (autoCancel) when the steering wheel has gone beyond 60 in the direction of the turn then returned toward neutral (threshold 10), for toggle_left/right_signal and for set_*_signal(state, true).
Inconsistency: M.resetLastStage points to the same function as M.initLastStage (which forces level 3 to 2).
Error risk: updateGFX evaluates `vals.parkingbrake > 0`; if parkingbrake_input was never written by a controller/input, the comparison is made on nil (Lua error).
toggle_lights cycles lightsState 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0; setLightsState has no validation.

values.desc: Table of current electrical values (see notes for the usual keys). Read by the UI, streams, sensors. Booleans are converted to 0/1 at the end of the 1st step.

disabledState.desc: Set of electrics.values keys to force to nil at each updateGFX (presence of the key is enough). Reset to {} by init and reset.

updateGFX.desc: 1st update step per frame: handles the held starter, the turn signal pulse, computes derived values (lights, ground speed, altitude, smoothed RPM...), injects remote electrics (beamstate.updateRemoteElectrics(true)), then converts booleans to 0/1 and clears the disabledState keys.

updateGFXSecondStep.desc: 2nd step, called after the controllers: computes brakelights, brakelight_signal_R/L, reinjects remote electrics, applies the override according to the ignition level (values set to 0 if ignitionLevel == 0), runs the jbeam custom values then the smoothers.

toggle_left_signal.desc: Toggles the left turn signal (user input). Cuts the right one and the warning when it activates; if the warning is active, forces the left to true. Plays the sounds if ignitionLevel > 0 and enables auto-cancel.

toggle_right_signal.desc: Toggles the right turn signal (same logic as toggle_left_signal).

set_left_signal.desc: Explicitly turns the left turn signal on or off (cuts right and warning on activation).

state.desc: true turns on, false turns off.

autoCancel.desc: If true (on activation), the turn signal stops when the steering wheel has returned to neutral after turning.

set_right_signal.desc: Explicitly turns the right turn signal on or off.

state.desc: true turns on, false turns off.

autoCancel.desc: Auto-cancel after a turn, like set_left_signal.

stop_turn_signal.desc: Turns off both turn signals (unless the warning is active, in which case does nothing) and plays the off sound.

set_warn_signal.desc: Enables or cuts the hazard lights; also sets the left and right states to the same value and disables auto-cancel.

toggle_lightbar_signal.desc: Moves to the next light bar state (0 off, 1 lights, 2 lights + siren if the 'siren' sound exists; otherwise 0/1).

set_lightbar_signal.desc: Sets the light bar state. The value is taken modulo 3 (modulo 2 if the vehicle has no 'siren' sound). State 2 plays the siren.

set_fog_lights.desc: Sets the fog light state (value stored as is then read in electrics.values.fog).

toggle_lights.desc: Cycles the headlight state: 0 off -> 1 low beam -> 2 high beam -> 0, with on/off sound.

toggle_highbeams.desc: Toggles between low beam (1) and high beam (2). No effect if the headlights are off.

light_flash_highbeams.desc: Headlight flash: at true, stores the current state and switches to high beam; at false, restores the stored state.

enabled.desc: true starts the headlight flash, false ends it.

setLightsState.desc: Directly sets the headlight state without validation (used by the radial menu).

horn.desc: Enables or cuts the horn (electrics.values.horn) and plays/stops the 'horn' sound (two alternating slots to avoid an abrupt cut).

setIgnitionLevel.desc: Sets the ignition level after filtering by the allowed levels, displays a UI message (levels 0 to 2) and commands the main controller: levels 0/1 cut ignition and starter, 2 turns ignition on without starter, 3 turns ignition on and engages the starter. Updates the values override.

toggleIgnitionLevelOnDown.desc: Start of the ignition key press: arms the counter; beyond 0.5 s held, goes to level 3 (starter).

toggleIgnitionLevelOnUp.desc: Ignition key release: advances the level 0 -> 1 -> 2, then 2 -> 1, 1 -> 0 (depending on the previous direction); level 3 falls back to 2.

setAllowedIgnitionLevels.desc: Defines the list of allowed ignition levels and rebuilds the substitution table (forbidden level -> nearest allowed higher level, otherwise lower). An empty list becomes {0}.

reset.desc: Called at vehicle reset: clears disabledState, resets the smoothers and base values to 0, restores the default custom values, the turn signal pulse and the spawn ignition level.

init.desc: Called at vehicle creation: reads the jbeam config (smoothers, custom values, ignition levels, turn signal cycle), compiles the custom values, sets the starting ignition level and registers the radial menu entries (core_quickAccess).

initLastStage.desc: Called at the end of initialization: if the ignition level is 3, brings it back to 2 (storing 3 as the previous level) so as not to stay in starter.
